effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If you have 3 or more security cards, you may add your top security card to the hand. Then, if you have 2 or fewer security cards, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, gain 1 memory.
